chunks: And a group informed me from Abu Muhammad Harun ibn Musa al-Talakbari from Abu Ali al-Razi from Ibn Abi Daram from Ali ibn al-Abbas al-Sandi al-Maqani from Muhammad ibn Hashim al-Qaisi from Sahl ibn Tamam al-Basri from Imran al-Qattan from Qatada from Abu Nadra from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari that he said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The Mahdi will emerge in the last period of time.

key_terms.آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ: The last period of time or end times
key_terms.الْمَهْدِيُّ: The Guided One, a title for the awaited Imam in Shia Islam

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the emergence of the Mahdi?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through a chain of prominent early narrators including Qatadah and Jabir ibn Abdullah, establishes the prophetic foretelling of the Mahdi's emergence in the 'end of times' (akhir al-zaman). It serves as a foundational textual proof in Shia eschatology, linking the Twelfth Imam's reappearance to established prophetic traditions and validating the concept of occultation and return.
